summary: The closure pass now drains independent closed-issue pull status reads through a four-worker pool before planning retirements, and the new fake-port test proves reduced wall time while preserving order, accounting, and write-after-read behavior.

evidence: `ops/hosted-autonomy-closure-pass.ts` lines 365-407 replace the serial status loop with a bounded four-worker pool and await all reads before planning or writing.

`tests/host/hosted-autonomy-retirement-throughput_test.ts` lines 83-142 assert peak concurrency 4, seven waves instead of 25 sequential round trips, 7000 ms instead of 25000 ms, and one write after reads settle.

The test also checks snapshot-order retirement actions, unchanged counters and reservations, and lines 144-208 cover slow, failed, merged, mismatched and still-open reads without manufacturing retirement evidence.
The changed-file manifest contains only the closure pass and this regression test; no threshold or gate file changed, preserving the task requirement not to raise limits.
